tasks.prompt: Before researching Elysium Health's product Basis, report what the graph already holds: the Organization and Product uids, every relationship type attached to the Product with counts, and the source locator that supports the HAS_VARIANT assertion. Write answer.json with keys organizationUid, productUid, relationshipTypes (list), locatorUid.
Which formulation version was attached to the Basis US capsules variant as of 2026-08-01, and what is the validity class of that episode? Write answer.json with keys formulationUid and validityClass.

From the capture at https://example.test/amazon/basis (observed 2026-09-01, Supplement Facts page shows 'Basis 60 capsules $60.00 ships from Amazon.com'), record a MerchantListing for the Basis US capsules variant hosted by Amazon (Organization, new, domain amazon.com), an Offer and a PriceObservation of 60.00 USD observed 2026-09-01. Attach ASIN B0TESTBASIS to the variant. Cite the capture for every fact.

checks.name: price observation
checks.cypher: MATCH (:MerchantListing)-[:HAS_OFFER]->(:Offer)-[:HAS_PRICE_OBSERVATION]->(p:PriceObservation) WHERE p.amount = 60.0 OR p.priceAmount = 60.0 OR p.valueNumber = 60.0 RETURN count(p) AS c

checks.name: asin attached
checks.cypher: MATCH (v:ProductVariant {uid: 'hu:product-variant:basis-us-capsules'})-[r:HAS_IDENTIFIER]->(i:Identifier) WHERE toUpper(i.scheme) = 'ASIN' AND i.value = 'B0TESTBASIS' RETURN count(i) AS c, count(r.assertionUid) AS withAssertion

checks.name: no duplicate amazon org
checks.cypher: MATCH (o:Organization) WHERE toLower(o.name) CONTAINS 'amazon' RETURN count(o) AS c

tasks.prompt: A later capture of the Basis label (observed 2026-09-15, same page) shows the US capsules variant now ships a new formulation with 300 mg nicotinamide riboside chloride per serving. Record the new FormulationVersion, end the previous HAS_FORMULATION_VERSION episode, and record the new declared amount. Do not delete anything.

checks.name: old episode closed
checks.cypher: MATCH (v:ProductVariant {uid: 'hu:product-variant:basis-us-capsules'})-[r:HAS_FORMULATION_VERSION]->(f {uid: 'hu:formulation:basis-us-2026-07-10'}) RETURN count(r) AS c, count(r.recordedTo) AS closed

checks.name: new episode open
checks.cypher: MATCH (v:ProductVariant {uid: 'hu:product-variant:basis-us-capsules'})-[r:HAS_FORMULATION_VERSION]->(f) WHERE r.recordedTo IS NULL AND f.uid <> 'hu:formulation:basis-us-2026-07-10' RETURN count(r) AS c, count(r.assertionUid) AS withAssertion

checks.name: amount recorded with evidence
checks.cypher: MATCH (a:Assertion {predicate: 'LABEL_DECLARED_AMOUNT'}) WHERE a.valueNumber = 300 AND (a)-[:SUPPORTED_BY]->(:SourceLocator) RETURN count(a) AS c

tasks.prompt: A podcast guest (Person, new: 'Dr. Example Guest') says on the episode at https://example.test/podcast/ep1 (media time 00:12:30-00:13:10, observed 2026-09-20) that they advise Elysium Health and that they take Basis every morning. Record what the source supports and nothing more.

checks.name: advises edge asserted
checks.cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[r:ADVISES_ORGANIZATION]->(o:Organization {uid: 'hu:org:elysium-health'}) RETURN count(r) AS c, count(r.assertionUid) AS withAssertion

checks.name: practice recorded as a claim with speech act
checks.cypher: MATCH (a:Assertion)-[:HAS_SUBJECT]->(p:Person) WHERE a.speechAct = 'REPORTS_PRACTICE' AND (a)-[:SUPPORTED_BY]->(:SourceLocator {selectorKind: 'MEDIA_TIME'}) RETURN count(a) AS c

kernelChecks.name: asserted edges carry episode fields
kernelChecks.cypher: MATCH ()-[r]->() WHERE r.assertionUid IS NOT NULL AND (r.relationshipUid IS NULL OR r.recordedFrom IS NULL OR r.validFromBasis IS NULL) RETURN count(r) AS violations

kernelChecks.name: assertions are generated by an activity
kernelChecks.cypher: MATCH (a:Assertion) WHERE NOT (a)-[:WAS_GENERATED_BY]->(:Activity) RETURN count(a) AS violations

kernelChecks.name: assertions have a subject
kernelChecks.cypher: MATCH (a:Assertion) WHERE NOT (a)-[:HAS_SUBJECT]->() RETURN count(a) AS violations

kernelChecks.name: nodes carry uid and marker
kernelChecks.cypher: MATCH (n) WHERE NOT n:KsIntentMarker AND NOT n:BksScratch AND (n.uid IS NULL OR (n.entityType IS NULL AND n.artifactType IS NULL AND n.occurrenceType IS NULL AND n.stateType IS NULL AND n.assessmentType IS NULL AND NOT n:Assertion)) RETURN count(n) AS violations

kernelChecks.name: no private uids
kernelChecks.cypher: MATCH (n) WHERE n.uid STARTS WITH 'hu:private-' OR n.uid STARTS WITH 'hu:user-context' RETURN count(n) AS violations
